counterbalance: mode order alternates by (scenario_index + round_index) parity; 6 Standard-first and 6 Fast-first pairs
runtime_policy: Freeze corrected v2 for a complete fresh four-scenario, three-round, 24-run campaign. Keep original fixtures, prompts, model Max, output budget, acceptance, order and quotas. Do not reuse, replace or mix v1 samples.
independent_quality: Immutable inputs, exact outputs, original code tests plus 16 formula cases; saved pipeline relationships; effective read-only inspector scopes; manual review of source-read and coordination/order provenance before final quality verdict
preflight: offline replay of all 5 actual false scope denials
quality_failure_policy: An attempted out-of-workspace call that was denied before execution is recorded separately from a successful scope violation; only full completion and all original protocol checks qualify a pair. Actual pending human approvals are captured, never auto-approved by this harness.
scope_limitation: Literal path and symlink preflight plus original approval; not a general OS sandbox or proof for all dynamically computed paths.
version: v2: semantic path preflight, adaptive exact evidence and valid transitive inputs
evidence_correction: Exact small ledgers are inline; large ledgers use scoped exact lookup with reasons. Legitimate transitive dependencies are exposed only at matching recorded artifact versions. Full reports/checks, independent verifiers and final review remain.
